## Snapshot

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### Current Position

PhD student in Ecology and Evolutionary Biology at Princeton University, working on animal communication, vocal learning, and sequence structure.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Core Areas

Bioacoustics, animal communication, social behaviour, network analysis, quantitative modeling, and applied machine learning for behavioural data.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Tools

Python, R, MATLAB, Raven Pro, warbleR, GLMMs, Bayesian modeling, HMMs, sequence models, and Raspberry Pi based recording systems.
:::
:::
